title: SkillManifest
description: Schema for a Life Savor skill manifest (skill.json). Defines the skill identity, entrypoint, capabilities, dependencies, configuration schema, setup workflow, and documentation references.

skill_id.description: Unique identifier for the skill. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the skill.

description.description: Short description of what the skill does.

execution_tier.description: Execution tier controlling resource limits and sandbox privileges. Valid values: 1, 2, or 3.

entrypoint.description: How to launch the skill process.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the process.

capabilities.description: Optional capability flags for the skill.

rag_provider.description: Whether this skill provides RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) content.

dependencies.description: Other skills this skill depends on.

setup_steps.description: Ordered list of setup steps that guide the user through configuring the skill. Requires config_schema to be defined.

ConfigSchema.description: JSON Schema-based configuration schema for a skill. Defines the typed fields a skill accepts as configuration (API keys, webhook URLs, toggle flags, etc.).

properties.description: Map of field name to field definition. Each property defines a configurable parameter for the skill.

ConfigFieldDefinition.description: Definition of a single configurable field within the config_schema.

type.description: JSON Schema type of the field.

description.description: Help text describing the fields purpose.

default.description: Default value for the field. Type should match the field type.

x-secret.description: When true, indicates this field holds a secret value (API key, token, etc.) that must be stored securely and masked in UI display.

items.description: For array fields: schema of array items.

SetupStep.description: A single step in a multi-step setup workflow. Groups related config fields into a guided experience with optional per-step validation.

step_id.description: Unique identifier within the skill (e.g. credentials, preferences).

description.description: Description text explaining what this step configures.

fields.description: Config field names from config_schema that belong to this step.

validation_command.description: Optional skill operation name that the agent invokes to validate the step field values before advancing.

SkillDocumentation.description: Documentation references bundled with a skill. Used by both human readers and the agent LLM for knowledge retrieval.

usage_guide.description: Relative path to the main usage guide Markdown file within the skill directory.

file.description: Relative path to the Markdown file.

CanvasCapability.description: Declares that this skill can render fullscreen content on agents that support canvas (tvOS, iOS, desktop). Skills with canvas capabilities can take over the screen with video, 3D scenes, declarative layouts, or images.

content_types.description: Types of canvas content this skill can render. At least one must be declared.

platforms.description: Platforms where canvas rendering is supported. If omitted, all canvas-capable platforms are assumed.

voice_interactive.description: Whether the skill accepts voice commands while the canvas is displayed. When true, voice input is forwarded to the skill via canvas_voice_input messages.

dismissible.description: Whether the user can dismiss the canvas at any time. Always true for safety — this field is informational.

requires_system_components.description: System components that must be installed for canvas rendering (e.g., unity-runtime, unreal-runtime). The platform will prompt the user to install these when the skill is installed.

CanvasAssets.description: Static assets bundled with the skill for canvas rendering. These are downloaded when the skill is installed and cached on the agent.

scenes.description: 3D scene assets (.scn, .usdz, .dae) included in the skill bundle.

videos.description: Video assets included in the skill bundle.

images.description: Image assets included in the skill bundle.

total_size_mb.description: Approximate total size of all canvas assets in megabytes. Shown to the user before installation.

id.description: Unique identifier for this asset (referenced in canvas commands).

path.description: Relative path to the asset within the skill bundle.
